name: @realitycollective/webxr-input
description: Shared, engine-free input contracts for the Reality Collective WebXR extension families: normalised input sources (rays, pinches, pokes, grips, hand joints, gaze, 2D pointers), capability negotiation, a pull-based provider interface, and pointer streams - consumable by the Interactions and UI Extensions families alike. Zero dependencies.
author: Reality Collective
